sections.title: What is ALX?
sections.text:
Question (en): What is ALX?
Answer (en): ALX equips young Africans through programmes it describes as rigorous and affordable, and through a community built on shared proof. The aim is to help them launch careers, build ventures, and create income on their own terms.
Question (am): ALX ምንድን ነው?
Answer (am): ALX ወጣት አፍሪካውያንን በምትገልጻቸው ጥብቅ እና ተመጣጣኝ ዋጋ ባላቸው ፕሮግራሞች እና በጋራ ማስረጃ በተገነባ ማህበረሰብ ታስታጥቃለች። ዓላማው ሙያ እንዲጀምሩ፣ ሥራ እንዲገነቡ እና በራሳቸው ውሳኔ ገቢ እንዲፈጥሩ መርዳት ነው።
Question (om): ALX maali?
Answer (om): ALX dargaggoota Afrikaa sagantaalee cimaa fi gatii mijaawaa jedhamaniin akkasumas hawaasa ragaa waliin qoodamuun ijaarrameen ni leenjifti. Kaayyoon isaa hojii akka jalqaban, dhaabbata akka ijaaran fi galii akka mataa isaaniitti akka uuman gargaaruudha.
Question (ti): ALX እንታይ እዩ?
Answer (ti): ALX መንእሰያት ኣፍሪቃ ብመደባት ጥንኩርን ብዝተመጣጠነ ዋጋን እትብሎምን ብሓባራዊ መርትዖ ዝተሰርሐ ማሕበረሰብን የዳልው። ዕላማኡ ሞያ ክጅምሩ፣ ስራሕ ክሰርሑን ብናይ ነብሶም ውሳነ ኣታዊ ክፈጥሩን ምሕጋዝ እዩ።
Question (so): Waa maxay ALX?
Answer (so): ALX waxay dhalinyarada Afrika ku qalabaysaa barnaamijyo ay ku tilmaanto kuwo adag oo la awoodi karo, iyo bulsho ku dhisan caddeyn wadaag ah. Ujeeddadu waa inay ka caawiso inay bilaabaan xirfado, dhisaan ganacsiyo, oo ay ku abuuraan dakhli si u gaar ah.
Question (ar): ما هي ALX؟
Answer (ar): تزوّد ALX الشباب الأفارقة ببرامج تصفها بأنها صارمة وميسورة التكلفة، وبمجتمع قائم على إثبات مشترك. الهدف هو مساعدتهم على بدء مسارات مهنية وبناء مشاريع وتحقيق دخل وفق شروطهم.

sections.title: What does ALX do?
sections.text:
Question (en): What does ALX do?
Answer (en): ALX says it turns ambition into outcomes at scale. It offers career and entrepreneurship programmes and a community where visible progress, such as graduates mentoring applicants and alumni hiring graduates, makes transformation more believable for other young Africans.
Question (am): ALX ምን ያደርጋል?
Answer (am): ALX ምኞትን በስፋት ወደ ውጤት እንደምትቀይር ትላለች። የሙያ እና የሥራ ፈጠራ ፕሮግራሞችን እና ማህበረሰብ ታቀርባለች። በዚህ ማህበረሰብ ውስጥ ተመራቂዎች አመልካቾችን መምራት እና የቀድሞ ተማሪዎች ተመራቂዎችን መቅጠር ያሉ የሚታዩ እድገቶች ለሌሎች ወጣት አፍሪካውያን ለውጥን የበለጠ የሚታመን ያደርጉታል።
Question (om): ALX maal hojjeta?
Answer (om): ALX hawwii gara bu’aatti bal’inaan akka jijjiirtu ni himti. Sagantaalee hojii fi daldalaa fi hawaasa ni kenna. Hawaasa kana keessatti guddina ifa ta’e, akka eebbifamtoonni iyyattoota gorsuu fi barattoonni durii eebbifamtoota qacarun, jijjiirama dargaggoota Afrikaa biroof amanamsiisa.
Question (ti): ALX እንታይ ይሰርሕ?
Answer (ti): ALX ተስፋ ናብ ውጽኢት ብሰፊሕ መጠን ከም እትቅይር ትብል። ናይ ሞያን ናይ ስራሕ ፈጠራን መደባትን ማሕበረሰብን ትህብ። ኣብዚ ማሕበረሰብ ዝረኣይ ምዕባለ፣ ከም ተመረቕቲ ነመልከቲ ምምራሕን ነባር ተመሃሮ ተመረቕቲ ምቕጻርን፣ ለውጢ ንኻልኦት መንእሰያት ኣፍሪቃ ዝያዳ የእምን።
Question (so): Maxay ALX qabataa?
Answer (so): ALX waxay sheegtaa inay himilada u beddesho natiijo baaxad leh. Waxay bixisaa barnaamijyo xirfadeed iyo ganacsi iyo bulsho ay horumarka la arki karo, sida qalinjabiyayaasha oo la taliya codsadayaasha iyo alumni-ga oo shaqaaleeya qalinjabiyayaasha, ka dhigto isbeddelka mid la aaminsan karo dhalinyarada kale ee Afrika.
Question (ar): ماذا تفعل ALX؟
Answer (ar): تقول ALX إنها تحوّل الطموح إلى نتائج على نطاق واسع. تقدّم برامج للمسار المهني وريادة الأعمال ومجتمعاً يجعل التقدّم المرئي، مثل توجيه الخريجين للمتقدمين وتوظيف الخريجين من قِبل الخريجين السابقين، التحول أكثر قابلية للتصديق لدى شباب أفارقة آخرين.

sections.title: What is the mission of ALX?
sections.text:
Question (en): What is the mission of ALX?
Answer (en): ALX states its mission as expanding career and entrepreneurial opportunity for young Africans by turning real outcomes into visible proof that transformation is possible. Its stated vision is a future where career transformation in Africa is no longer questioned, because millions of young Africans have already proven it is possible.
Question (am): የALX ተልዕኮ ምንድን ነው?
Answer (am): ALX ተልዕኮዋን ለወጣት አፍሪካውያን የሙያ እና የሥራ ፈጠራ እድልን ማስፋት ብላ ትገልጸዋለች። ይህን የምታደርገው እውነተኛ ውጤቶችን ለውጥ እንደሚቻል ወደሚታይ ማስረጃ በመቀየር ነው። የተገለጸው ራዕይ በአፍሪካ የሙያ ለውጥ ከእንግዲህ ጥያቄ የማይሆንበት ወደፊት ነው፤ ምክንያቱም በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ወጣት አፍሪካውያን ይህ እንደሚቻል አስቀድመው አረጋግጠዋል።
Question (om): Ergama ALX maali?
Answer (om): ALX ergamni ishee carraa hojii fi daldalaa dargaggoota Afrikaa bal’isuu akka ta’e himti. Kana kan gootu bu’aa dhugaa jijjiiramni akka danda’amu ragaa mul’atuutti jijjiiruudhaan. Mul’anni ishee gara fuulduraa jijjiiramni hojii Afrikaa keessatti gaaffii hin taaneedha, sababni isaas dargaggoonni Afrikaa miliyoonotaan lakkaa’aman dursee akka danda’amu mirkaneessaniiru.
Question (ti): ተልእኾ ALX እንታይ እዩ?
Answer (ti): ALX ተልእኮኣ ንመንእሰያት ኣፍሪቃ ዕድል ሞያን ስራሕ ፈጠራን ምስፋሕ ምዃኑ ትገልጽ። እዚ ብምግባር ናይ ሓቂ ውጽኢታት ለውጢ ከም ዝከኣል ናብ ዝረአ መርትዖ ትቅይሮ። እቲ ዝተገልጸ ራእይ፣ ኣብ ኣፍሪቃ ለውጢ ሞያ ድሕሪ ሕጂ ሕቶ ዘይኮነሉ መጻኢ እዩ፣ ምኽንያቱ ብሚልዮናት ዝቑጸሩ መንእሰያት ኣፍሪቃ ከም ዝከኣል ቅድሚ ሕጂ ኣረጋጊጾም እዮም።
Question (so): Waa maxay himilada ALX?
Answer (so): ALX waxay himiladeeda ku sheegtaa ballaarinta fursadda xirfadeed iyo ganacsiga ee dhalinyarada Afrika, iyadoo natiijooyinka dhabta ah u beddelaysa caddeyn la arki karo oo muujinaysa in isbeddelku suurtagal yahay. Aragtida ay sheegtay waa mustaqbal aan isbeddelka xirfadeed ee Afrika mar dambe la su’aalin, sababtoo ah malaayiin dhalinyaro Afrika ah ayaa horay u caddeeyay inuu suurtagal yahay.
Question (ar): ما رسالة ALX؟
Answer (ar): تصف ALX رسالتها بأنها توسيع فرص المسار المهني وريادة الأعمال للشباب الأفارقة، بتحويل النتائج الحقيقية إلى دليل مرئي على أن التحول ممكن. الرؤية التي تذكرها هي مستقبل لا يعود فيه التحول المهني في أفريقيا موضع سؤال، لأن ملايين الشباب الأفارقة أثبتوا بالفعل أنه ممكن.

sections.title: Who does ALX serve?
sections.text:
Question (en): Who does ALX serve?
Answer (en): ALX serves young Africans who want career and entrepreneurial opportunity. Its programmes and community are for people who want to build skills, launch careers, start ventures, or create income.
Question (am): ALX ማንን ያገለግላል?
Answer (am): ALX የሙያ እና የሥራ ፈጠራ እድል የሚፈልጉ ወጣት አፍሪካውያንን ታገለግላለች። ፕሮግራሞቿ እና ማህበረሰቧ ክህሎት መገንባት፣ ሙያ መጀመር፣ ሥራ ማስጀመር ወይም ገቢ መፍጠር ለሚፈልጉ ሰዎች ናቸው።
Question (om): ALX eenyuuf tajaajila?
Answer (om): ALX dargaggoota Afrikaa carraa hojii fi daldalaa barbaadan tajaajilti. Sagantaaleen fi hawaasni ishee dandeettii ijaaruu, hojii jalqabuu, dhaabbata jalqabuu ykn galii uumuu barbaadaniif.
Question (ti): ALX መን ትግልግል?
Answer (ti): ALX መንእሰያት ኣፍሪቃ ዕድል ሞያን ስራሕ ፈጠራን ዝደልዩ ትግልግል። መደባታን ማሕበረሰባን ንሰባት ክእለት ዝደልዩ፣ ሞያ ክጅምሩ፣ ስራሕ ክጅምሩ ወይ ኣታዊ ክፈጥሩ እዮም።
Question (so): Yaa ay ALX u adeegtaa?
Answer (so): ALX waxay u adeegtaa dhalinyarada Afrika ee raadinaysa fursad xirfadeed iyo ganacsi. Barnaamijyadeeda iyo bulshadeedu waxay u yihiin dadka doonaya inay dhistaan xirfado, bilaabaan xirfad, bilaabaan ganacsi, ama abuuraan dakhli.
Question (ar): من تخدم ALX؟
Answer (ar): تخدم ALX الشباب الأفارقة الذين يسعون إلى فرصة مهنية أو ريادية. برامجها ومجتمعها موجهان لمن يريد بناء المهارات أو بدء مسار مهني أو إطلاق مشروع أو تحقيق دخل.

sections.title: What is the ALX community?
sections.text:
Question (en): What is the ALX community?
Answer (en): ALX describes its community as built on shared proof. It describes graduates mentoring applicants, alumni hiring graduates, and communities seeing someone succeed and deciding they can too. ALX states that 300,000 people have built something that compounds.
Question (am): የALX ማህበረሰብ ምንድን ነው?
Answer (am): ALX ማህበረሰቧን በጋራ ማስረጃ ላይ እንደተገነባ ትገልጸዋለች። ተመራቂዎች አመልካቾችን እንደሚመሩ፣ የቀድሞ ተማሪዎች ተመራቂዎችን እንደሚቀጥሩ እና ማህበረሰቦች አንድ ሰው ሲሳካ አይተው እነሱም እንደሚችሉ እንደሚወስኑ ትገልጻለች። ALX 300,000 ሰዎች የሚጨምር ነገር እንደገነቡ ትናገራለች።
Question (om): Hawaasni ALX maali?
Answer (om): ALX hawaasa ishee ragaa waliin qoodamuun akka ijaarame ibsiti. Eebbifamtoonni iyyattoota akka gorsan, barattoonni durii eebbifamtoota akka qacaran, hawaasni immoo nama tokko milkaa’e arguun isaanis akka danda’an akka murteessan ibsiti. ALX namoonni 300,000 waan dachaan guddatu ijaaranii akka jiran himti.
Question (ti): ማሕበረሰብ ALX እንታይ እዩ?
Answer (ti): ALX ማሕበረሰባ ብሓባራዊ መርትዖ ከም ዝተሰርሐ ትገልጽ። ተመረቕቲ ነመልከቲ ከም ዝመርሑ፣ ነባር ተመሃሮ ተመረቕቲ ከም ዝቕጽሩ፣ ማሕበረሰባት ድማ ሰብ ሓደ ምስ ረኣዩ ይኽእሉ ከም ዝብሉ ትገልጽ። ALX 300,000 ሰባት ዝውስኽ ነገር ከም ዝሰርሑ ትብል።
Question (so): Waa maxay bulshada ALX?
Answer (so): ALX waxay bulshadeeda ku tilmaamtaa mid ku dhisan caddeyn wadaag ah. Waxay sheegtaa in qalinjabiyayaashu la taliyaan codsadayaasha, alumni-gu shaqaalaysiiyo qalinjabiyayaasha, bulshoyinkuna ay arkaan qof guuleysta oo ay go’aansadaan inay iyaguna awoodaan. ALX waxay sheegtaa in 300,000 qof ay dhisteen wax isku dara.
Question (ar): ما هو مجتمع ALX؟
Answer (ar): تصف ALX مجتمعها بأنه مبني على إثبات مشترك. تصف خريجين يوجّهون المتقدمين، وخريجين سابقين يوظّفون الخريجين، ومجتمعات ترى نجاح أحد الأشخاص فتقرر أنها تستطيع ذلك أيضاً. تذكر ALX أن 300,000 شخص بنوا شيئاً يتراكم أثره.

sections.title: Which programmes does ALX offer?
sections.text:
Question (en): Which programmes does ALX offer?
Answer (en): On its programmes page, ALX groups programmes as AI & Data (Data Analytics, Data Science, and AI & Career Essentials), Creative (Content Creation and Graphic Design), and Entrepreneurship (Founder Academy and Freelancer Academy). That page is the source of the current list. Check the official programme page for eligibility, opening dates, and current availability. This bot does not promise admission, a job, or income.
Question (am): ALX የትኞቹን ፕሮግራሞች ታቀርባለች?
Answer (am): በፕሮግራሞች ገጿ ላይ ALX ፕሮግራሞችን እንደ AI እና ዳታ (Data Analytics፣ Data Science እና AI & Career Essentials)፣ ፈጠራ (Content Creation እና Graphic Design) እና ሥራ ፈጠራ (Founder Academy እና Freelancer Academy) ትመድባለች። ያ ገጽ የአሁኑ ዝርዝር ምንጭ ነው። ብቃት፣ የመክፈቻ ቀን እና ወቅታዊ ተገኝነትን በይፋዊው የፕሮግራም ገጽ ይመልከቱ። ይህ ቦት ቅበላ፣ ሥራ ወይም ገቢ ቃል አይገባም።

Answer (ti): ALX መንገድታት ትምህርቲ ምስ ዳታ፣ ኣርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ፣ ምፍጣር ትሕዝቶ፣ ግራፊክ ዲዛይን፣ ስራሕ ምስራሕን ፍሪላንስን ዝተኣሳሰሩ ትገልጽ። እዚኦም መደባት ትምህርቲ እዮም፣ ናይ ስራሕ ቅድመ-ዓይነት ኣይኮኑን። መደብ ምዝዛም ስራሕ ወይ ኣታዊ ኣይዋሕስን።

sections.title: Where can I get ALX support?
sections.text:
Question (en): Where can I get ALX support?
Answer (en): Official ALX support is the eHub portal: https://ehub.alxafrica.com/. This bot can share FAQ answers. If the bot operator has connected a support chat, you can ask the bot to forward a question there. A forward happens only after Telegram accepts the message, and it is separate from eHub.

Answer (ti): ወግዓዊ ደገፍ ALX ፖርታል eHub እዩ፦ https://ehub.alxafrica.com/። እዚ ቦት መልሲ FAQ ክካፈል ይኽእል። ኦፐረተር ደገፍ ዕላል እንተ ኣራኺቡ፣ ሕቶ ናብኡ ክስደድ ክትሓቱ ትኽእሉ። ምስዳድ ቴሌግራም ነቲ መልእኽቲ ምስ ተቐበለ ጥራይ እዩ፣ ካብ eHub’ውን ፍሉይ እዩ።

sections.title: ALX career pathways
sections.text: The ALX homepage groups career pathways into three areas. AI & Data is described as preparation for roles in data and AI. Creative is described as getting hired as a professional creative or earning independently with a portfolio. Entrepreneurship is described as launching a freelance career, starting a venture, or building income streams. The page does not promise a job or an income.

sections.title: Figures published on the ALX homepage
sections.text: The ALX homepage publishes these figures: 347.1K total number of graduates, 43.4K young entrepreneurs supported, 257.9K total youth in work, and 60.1K jobs created through entrepreneurship. These are the figures printed on that page. This assistant does not update them live.

sections.title: How the Data Analytics programme is described
sections.text: The Data Analytics programme page lists a duration of 7 weeks at 20 hours per week and a beginner level. It says companies hire people who can turn data into decisions. The knowledge areas it names are Data and AI Literacy Foundations, Data Analytics with Spreadsheets, SQL for Data, and Power BI for Data Analytics. Spreadsheets cover cleaning, governance, and descriptive analytics. SQL covers querying relational data and an introduction to PostgreSQL. Power BI covers data modeling, Power Query, DAX expressions, and dashboards. The current start date is not stored here. Check the programme page.

sections.title: What data analytics means on the ALX programme page
sections.text: The Data Analytics page says data analytics is examining data to find patterns, draw conclusions, and support decision-making. It says data analysts collect and clean data, apply statistical methods, build visualisations, and translate findings into insights. It names roles such as Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Database Analyst, Junior Data Analyst, Operations Analyst, and Marketing Analyst, across finance, healthcare, marketing, operations, government, and technology. It says the programme builds from the ground up and that prior coding experience or advanced mathematics is not required. It says logical thinking, interest in how organisations make decisions, and practice with SQL and Power BI are what a learner needs. After the programme, the page says a learner can collect and clean raw datasets, run descriptive and statistical analysis, write SQL queries, build Power BI dashboards, and present data-driven recommendations. It does not promise a job.

sections.title: Professional Foundations and Data Analytics
sections.text: The Data Analytics page says that completing the first Data Analytics short course automatically enrols a learner in Professional Foundations, and that both continue in parallel. It says Professional Foundations is required for the Data Analytics Programme Certificate, and that a learner does not need to finish it before continuing the Data Analytics short courses. It says a learner who already completed Professional Foundations in a previous programme is not asked to repeat it.

sections.title: ALX CHAIR values
sections.text: The application article says ALX looks for learners who align with its CHAIR values: Courage, Humility, Adventure, Initiative, and Resilience. It says those values run from application to graduation, and that an open mindset helps a learner get more from the experience. It gives persisting through the application until it is submitted as an example of resilience.

sections.title: How the application article says to choose a programme
sections.text: The application article says a person can judge fit by time commitment, career goals, and interests. It says some programmes ask for at least 20 hours per week and others ask for 70 hours per week. It says learners should read what each programme offers. It says ALX has a Programme Finder tool to help with that choice. The current list of programmes is on https://www.alxafrica.com/programmes/.

sections.title: What learners gain besides technical skills
sections.text: The application article says many applicants expect only technical skills for jobs. It says that after joining, learners also get a community, mentorship, and soft-skills training. It says an accepted learner gets access to a community and continuous career support. It does not promise a job or an income.

sections.title: Application tips and deferral
sections.text: The application article's tips are: be authentic, seek help, and follow the instructions before each section. Help channels it names are other applicants, weekly office hours, resources on the application page, and the support team. It says an unfinished application is stored so the person does not have to enter every detail again. It says someone who is accepted and cannot join can defer enrolment to the next cohort. Deadlines are not stored here.

sections.title: What the site says about cost and sponsorship
sections.text: The ALX homepage says a partnership with the Mastercard Foundation allows eligible learners to access sponsored programme training, global university partners, a peer learning community, and online and in-person infrastructure for $5 a month. The application article says the same partnership offers eligible candidates tuition sponsorship to pursue programmes at no cost, and that a learner admitted to a paid programme on full tuition sponsorship pays a one-time non-refundable administration fee. It describes the eligibility it states for that sponsorship as being between 18 and 34 and of African origin. It does not state the administration fee amount. The two pages do not state the same price. This assistant does not choose between them and does not store a current fee. Check https://www.alxafrica.com/programmes/ for the current cost and eligibility.
